title: SEKTION wall cabinet with 2 doors
description: SEKTION wall cabinet with 2 doors, white/Nickebo matte anthracite, 24x15x30" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with NICKEBO fronts in matt black, you get a stylish and modern look that is easy to personalize.
features: To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
Requires a knob or a handle
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside/ Backside: Plastic foil (min. 90% recycled); Edge: Plastic edging (min. 50% recycled); Frame: Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging; Back: Fiberboard, Plastic foil; Steel, Nickel plated; Particleboard, Melamine foil, Plastic edging
